A billing ledger table has outgrown a single unpartitioned layout. Plan its
migration to a partitioned table with no write downtime. Cover the backfill
strategy, verification before cutover, the read cutover itself, rollback, and
who owns the decision to drop the old table.

Produce a plan of roughly 600 words.
